summary: All acceptance criteria met and verified. Database schema successfully updated via Neon MCP with all required fields: (1) doctors.centerId is nullable, DOCTOR role added to user_role enum, doctors table has userId, isIndependent, specialization, consultationFee fields. (2) centers table has commissionRate, commissionType (default PERCENTAGE), fixedCommissionAmount fields. (3) bookings table has commissionAmount, commissionStatus (default PENDING), centerEarnings, checkedInAt, checkedOutAt, checkedInBy, checkedOutBy fields. (4) Commission calculation logic correctly handles PERCENTAGE (price * rate/100) and FIXED types in checkout route. (5) API routes properly validate center ownership via doctor lookup and enforce CENTER role. (6) UI displays check-in button for CONFIRMED bookings and check-out button for checked-in bookings, with commission breakdown display. TypeScript compilation passes. All code follows existing patterns and conventions.
